title: microplastic, water column, seston bacteria communities
description: Here we compare bacterial community composition on microplastic to natural microbial habitats. Upstream water column samples and downstream water column, seston, and microplastic samples were collected from receiving wastewater treatment plant effluent. Using 16S rRNA gene sequencing we characterized community membership and structure to compare bacterial assemblages across habitats and rivers
